svg.title: LDA on the SFDA toy example
svg.desc: Top: two Gaussian class densities of equal width, class A centred at minus 1.44 and its mirror class B at plus 1.44, with the four class A samples marked on the axis. Bottom: the posterior probability of class A as a function of x, a sigmoid that equals one half at the decision boundary x equals 0, with the four samples marked on it.
svg.text: LDA on the toy (Model Y): each class is a Gaussian with the same width; the posterior p(A | x) follows from Bayes' rule
class-conditional densities p(x | A), p(x | B)
steeper when the class means are farther apart
